answer: Disposable aliases cannot book the same quay. An applicant bonds 33.2 POA and reserves slip H14 in the north harbor for 64 minutes. At solar nadir they lower a 2.15 kg lead and log 13 draft-and-current pairs every 85 seconds. Peers recompute both from tide gauge T2 and the anemometer on granite ridge R6; draft stays within 1.2 cm and current within 0.07 m/s. A second H14 booking, or a hydrograph within 1.8% RMSE of another ticket, slashes the bond and voids both seats. If a squall knocks the lead off-vertical before sample 7, half is refunded and H14 stays dark 21 hours with a new serial.
